text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is recommending that overnight on-street permit parking be introduced on Maclean Avenue between Pine Crescent and Queen Street East from 12:01 a.m. to 7:00 a.m., daily. Residents requested the implementation of overnight on-street permit parking on Maclean Avenue between Pine Crescent and Queen Street East to accommodate their long-term parking needs.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Authorized parking by permit on an area named basis within Permit Parking Area 9C, to be in effect from 12:01 a.m. to 7:00 a.m. daily on the odd (east) side of Maclean Avenue from Pine Crescent to Queen Street East.
